title: MAKE GROUND — Better Hole 001
subtitle: One passage. One human hinge. One return.
author: LemonPRESS · The Static Collective

source.title: MAKE GROUND — A Field Manual for Growing Possible Futures
source.source_ref: Chapter 1 — Make Better Holes / The Better Hole Test

encounters.title: Make a Better Hole
encounters.text: Choose one ordinary unresolved problem. Before trying to solve it, change the representation: draw it, map it, photograph it from another angle, make a timeline, or arrange the parts physically. The test is not whether you solve the old question. The test is whether a new question becomes reachable.

doors.title: TAKE
doors.prompt: Run the Better Hole Test now. Make one representation change, notice one newly reachable question, and return with only what actually happened.

doors.title: HOLD
doors.prompt: Do not run the experiment yet. Preserve the unresolved problem and record what condition, evidence, or readiness is still missing.

doors.title: PASS
doors.prompt: Decline this door. Record why this is the wrong problem, wrong time, or wrong instrument rather than forcing participation.
